properties.basis_en: West borderland of Ali Dinar's restored sultanate: Dar Masalit is 'bounded to the west by Wadai… to the north by Dars Tama and Kimr, and to the east by the Fur', and Dar Tama 'has always been a bone of contention between the Sultans of Wadai and Darfur' (MacMichael I pp.85–86); of Dar Masalit itself: 'Like Dar Tama it has always been a bone of contention as between Wadai and Darfur' (ibid.); the sultanate was 'nominally tributary to, but effectively independent of, the Anglo-Egyptian Sudan' (GHA VII p.283). Shown as a single APPROXIMATE point at the Dar Masalit anchor; no Dar Tama point because no sourced historical coordinate was found (Wikidata Q2439275 is the modern Chadian Dar Tama Department, not used).
